title: Cyber Network Operations Officer (II) (LtCol to Capt) PMOS, DIR IC4
raw_text:
3. MOS 0605, Cyber Network Operations Officer (II) (LtCol to Capt) PMOS, DIR
IC4

    a. Summary. The Cyber Network Operations Officer plans, synchronizes,
and integrates the overall operational and strategic goals of enterprise
Marine Corps communications and Department of Defense Information Network
Operations (DoDIN Ops). Evaluates and recommends changes to current and
future cyberspace operations in support of warfighting functions and mission
requirements. They are responsible for the operational integration of Marine
Corps information systems including command and control (C2), intelligence,
surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and logistics with naval, joint and
coalition networks. They are responsible for the secure implementation of
DoDIN Ops and integration with defensive cyberspace operations (DCO) across
the enterprise. They provide the commander with expert advice on cyber risks
and mitigation actions in order to enable assured C2 and improve decision
making ability. The duties include providing technical expertise to the
commander; serving as a DODIN Ops SME to boards, bureaus, centers, cells, and
working groups (B2C2WG), managing command cyber security programs; providing
advanced technical support to the development and maintenance of related
plans, policies, procurements, and procedures in support of DODIN Ops,
coordinating with the (G/J/C)2/3/5 staffs within MAGTF, joint, and coalition
environments to synchronize the DoDIN Ops with cyberspace operations.

       b.   Prerequisites

        (1) Security requirement:         top secret with sensitive compartmented
information access eligibility.

        (2) Limited duty officers assigned this MOS must have previously
served as a chief warrant officer with the PMOSs 0630 or 0670.

        (3) Must meet eligibility and appointment criteria as prescribed in
MCO 1040.42B, WO and LDO accession programs.




                                            1-45                        Enclosure (1)
 1109                                                                 NAVMC 1200.1L



       c.   Requirements

            (1) Complete one of the following:

                (a) Network Engineering Officers Course (M09CVM1).

                (b) Data Systems Engineering Officers Course (M093861).

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (i), Communications Training and Readiness Manual.

    e.      Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
None.

       f.   Related Military Skill

            (1) Network Engineering Officer, 0630.

            (2) Network Chief, 0639.

            (3) Data Systems Engineering Officer, 0670.

            (4) Data Systems Chief, 0679.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
